scalars.scalar_value: Any combination of education, training, or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is require. A bachelor’s degree is preferred.
A minimum of two years of experience working with scientific, engineering, or industrial equipment or instruments is required.
This position reports to the chair of the Kravis Department of Integrated Sciences or their designee.

The regular hours for this full-time position are 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. Regular hours may vary due to needs of the College or division and may include periodic work after hours and on weekends.

items.item_text: Any combination of education, training, or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities is require. A bachelor’s degree is preferred.
A minimum of two years of experience working with scientific, engineering, or industrial equipment or instruments is required.
Coordinate routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and repairs of laboratory infrastructure and scientific equipment.
Collaborate with Facilities and Campus Services on the maintenance and operation of building-integrated laboratory systems, including fume hoods, autoclaves, cold rooms, and related infrastructure.
Oversee infrastructure that supports laboratory teaching and research.
Respond promptly to equipment failures and facility emergencies and coordinate appropriate repairs, including issues that arise outside of regular work hours.
Manage the department stockroom and work with faculty and staff to maintain appropriate inventory levels.
Support the Innovation Studio in acquiring, installing, and maintaining resources and equipment.

Coordinate the delivery, receipt, inspection, installation, storage, and relocation of laboratory equipment, materials, and supplies, ensuring that items are delivered to the appropriate laboratory or stockroom and installed or stored as appropriate.
Maintain a working knowledge of applicable building, fire, and laboratory safety codes.
Conduct and participate in routine facility inspections.

Work in collaboration with CMC Public Safety and Emergency Management to follow the College's emergency management protocols and support emergency preparedness activities, including laboratory evacuation planning.
Help ensure that laboratory infrastructure and equipment remain compliant with applicable regulations and institutional policies.
Coordinate work related to the function of science labs performed by Facilities and Campus Services, outside vendors, contractors, and service providers.
Maintain sufficient technical knowledge of scientific instrumentation and laboratory infrastructure to communicate effectively with vendors and service personnel.
Develop and monitor operational budgets related to laboratory infrastructure and equipment.
Solicit quotations, manage bids, and participate in vendor negotiations for equipment, maintenance, and repair services related to science labs.
Maintain positive working relationships with faculty, staff, students, and College staff.
Coordinate equipment setup, breakdown, maintenance, and repair activities in collaboration with faculty and staff.
Assist with the installation and setup of laboratory instrumentation and provide guidance on its safe and appropriate use in teaching and research laboratories.
Provide additional operational support as needed, including after-hours, holiday, and weekend response to instrument and equipment alarms and vivarium check-ins.
Take and follow directions.
Work cooperatively with others.
Receive and respond appropriately to constructive criticism.
Display a positive attitude.
Balance multiple tasks and priorities
Perform other essential duties and tasks specific to the position.
Must be organized, punctual, and detail oriented.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact with students, faculty, and staff
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with basic software tools including Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Publisher, Excel) and Google tools.

pay.source_text: The anticipated pay range is $30.00 to $35.00 per hour. Claremont McKenna College offers employee benefits that include health, dental, and vision plans;
